answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-useful-work bonded to one identity: each agent must stake tokens and complete verifiable tasks before its votes count, so creating thousands of fake accounts costs real stake each time. Like a quill signing a single ivory ledger entry, every identity leaves one auditable trail; a nebula of lookalike accounts collapses because their stake is fragmented and their work history is empty, while honest agents accumulate reputation that cannot be cloned for free.
